sections.indications_and_usage: USES: temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
sections.dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS: adults and children 12 years and over ■ take 1 tablet every 4 hours ■ do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours children under 12 years ask a doctor
sections.warnings_and_cautions: WARNINGS Do not use if you are now taking a prescription monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) (certain drugs for depression, psychiatric or emotional conditions, or Parkinson's disease), or for 2 weeks after stopping the MAOI drug. If you do not know if your prescription drug contains an MAOI, ask a doctor or pharmacist before taking this product.
